messages:
maria: Quick sync — final pass on landing copy + webinar cadence for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Need alignment by EOD Fri. TL;DR: single flow with mode-specific CTAs, a benchmark narrative post, webinar signup, and inbound routing rules.

alex: Got it. Can we keep Hosted hero messaging focused on 'fastest time-to-value' and Dedicated on 'predictable throughput & isolation'?

jordan: +1. Private landing should be security-first — mention VPC/HSM and audit logs up front.

lee: Routing note: webinar regs should hit SDR queue A, benchmark downloads -> inbound MQL flow. Will map to SFDC tags.

nina: I pushed copy suggestions into the Figma file: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/landing-copy — quick Hosted hero option: "Ship LLM features fast — hosted API with predictable performance and streaming response support."

maria: Nice. For the benchmark post we need a tight narrative: latency vs cost chart, short customer quote, 3 bullet takeaways. @alex can you draft a 1–2 line callout for Dedicated latency/SLOs?

alex: Draft: "Dedicated pools: 99.9% uptime backed by SLA, <30ms median token latency on typical 2k-seq workloads." Is that okay or too specific?

jordan: Lean away from raw ms unless we've validated on our public benchmarks. Maybe "industry-leading median latency for production NLP workloads" + link to benchmark doc.

alex: Good call — will update to non-numeric.

maria: Webinar plan: 45 min total — 25 min demo (Hosted + Dedicated + Private highlights), 15 min live Q&A, quick customer panel. CTA to register and pick track. Need moderator and 1 customer speaker.

sam: I can moderate. @nina can you reach out to Alan at BetaCorp for a short case slot?

nina: Pinged Alan just now. If he can't do it, I have a backup customer who can speak to Dedicated SLA benefits.

lee: Proposed routing config (snippet) — this maps reg types to SFDC and nurture flows:

```yaml
routing:
  webinar_registrations:
    sfdc_queue: 'webinar_sdr'
    tags: ['webinar','product_launch']
  benchmark_downloads:
    mql_score: +50
    nurture_sequence: 'benchmarks_7day'
```

maria: That looks solid. Also: for meta descriptions/SEO I’ll do a one-pass tomorrow morning and drop copy in the doc. We should keep headlines short (60–70 chars) and include mode keywords (Hosted API, Dedicated, Private).

jordan: No blockers from product. (reaction: :thumbsup:)

deploy-bot: Reminder — marketing content freeze window starts at 2777772800. Please freeze copy at T-48h and confirm in this thread.

maria: Will confirm freeze in this thread once copy is in Figma. Thanks everyone — aim to have final CTA language + webinar landing by EOD Thu.
